title: Micro-sprint daily triage and account nudges
body:
Quick morning micro-sprint notes — keep short. Timestamped checkpoints for today (timebox).

09:00–09:20: inbox triage (tickets, slack pings)
09:20–09:40: renewals nudges (top 3)
09:40–10:10: prepare Blake Retail QBR pre-read
10:10–10:30: call with Aisha — DS/usage anomalies for BetaCo
11:00–11:30: internal sync SRE on CS-4821 latency spike follow-up

Top-of-mind accounts (quick lines):
- Blake Retail Co. (renewal target 2026-05-05) — ask Finance for committed monthly spend last 90d; run per-route latency breakdown (console -> exports). Pull last QBR deck (v2). TODO: attach cost-delta slide + three mitigation options (batching + smaller model variant + scheduled cache warm).
- BetaCo (pilot) — weird token misalignment reported 04/19 in logs; Diego to confirm sample prompts. Agenda for 10:10: confirm repro steps, decide whether to escalate to runtime team.
- Clearpoint Partners — champion wants demo of Dedicated; send comparison one-pager and infra checklist after 1pm.

Support follow-ups (short actions):
- CS-4821 (latency spike) — status: assigned to SRE (Priya). Actions: capture trace for 2026-04-20 22:14–22:30, confirm whether fallback policy kicked (model-variant fallback). If not, open incident doc and flag next-day on-call. Quick note to send customer: "We're investigating a transient latency regression from last night; will update by EOD with root cause and mitigation plan."
- CS-4902 (embedding mismatch) — pending sample from product. Reminder: ask for full prompt + model id + quantization profile.

Pre-read checklist for QBRs (mini-template to reuse):
- One-slide summary: "Health at a glance" (usage trend, cost trend, latency P50/P95, error rate)
- Top 3 wins since last QBR (deployments, cache wins, cost drops)
- Top 2 risks & mitigation (capacity, model drift)
- Ask / decisions needed (renewal term, Dedicated vs Hosted, SLA level)
- Action items table with owner + ETA

Email snippets (copy/paste and adapt):
- Renewal nudges (short):
  Subject: Quick sync re: Redwood renewal — 15m?
  Hi [Name],
  Quick check-in: our renewal on 2026-05-05 is coming up. I want to share a 5-min update on usage and potential optimizations we can put in place to reduce unit cost. Any chance for a 15-minute sync this week?
  Thanks, Kevin

- Incident ack to customer:
  Subject: Acknowledgement: latency issue 2026-04-20
  Hi [Customer],
  We saw a transient latency regression in your requests between 22:10–22:40 UTC on 2026-04-20. We're actively investigating and will follow up by EOD with a summary and next steps. Apologies for the disruption — prioritizing a root cause and mitigation.
  — Kevin, Customer Success

Quick heuristics / troubleshooting notes (to self):
- If P95 jumps but P50 stable -> likely tail behavior (check queue/batching, oversized requests).
- If many short requests suddenly appear -> caching warm missed or cold-starts in Dedicated autoscaler config.
- Repro locally: pin model vX.Y and run sample workload from customer logs (match seq length distribution).

Unresolved questions / decisions: (capture to follow up in slack)
- Blake Retail: confirm whether they will accept 2% annual price uplift; if not, build alternate commit plan.
- BetaCo pilot: do they need private deployment for compliance? Product asked for list of data ingress guarantees required.

Random notes & scratch items (choppy):
- Pull cost by model for Blake + Tag usage by route (billing export)
- Make small demo of Dedicated provisioning times for Clearpoint
- Check runbook link: /confluence/ops/oncall/fallbacks (can't find? ask SRE)
- Add sample prompts from BetaCo to GH gist (for reproductions)

End-of-day closeout (my checklist):
- update CS tracker rows for accounts touched
- add actions to QBR deck as tasks (owner + ETA)
- quick note to Diego: confirm whether sample triggers embedding mismatch, drop in GH issue if yes

Notes-to-self: keep QBR pre-reads 2 slides max for exec; deep-dive appendices OK. Use simple visual: 2x sparkline (usage, cost) + 2 bullets for risks.

Last-minute reminders (tiny):
- Slack DM Aisha: "10:10 ok? send sample prompts pls"
- Calendar: block 09:20–09:40 for renewals nudges (do not let meetings take this)
